handoff: Weather numbers softened (shortage x1.3 with bigger hunger, congestion 2 cycles). Mood and traffic counts set.

shortage_demand_mult.why: demand x1.3 for 3 cycles with a 1-cycle telegraph: a chance (hungry price), not a trap (worst case 1.5 steps of progress lost)

shortage_hunger_steps.why: 3 extra steps = +30 percent price at the world: riding it pays

congestion_cycles.why: trip x1.5 (about +30 per trip) for 2 cycles: a nuisance, easy to dodge

weather_next_soften_pct.why: a chain option softens a house by 35 percent

mood_branch_dark.why: kept: test moods needs one choice to tint (+-6 = threshold)

traffic_orbit_t2.why: orbital ships 3/5/8 per tier: readable density, under the 30 per world budget

details.sim: not run (owner instruction: no sim, bots or QA). Numbers reasoned by hand: a lane ship moves 20 units/cycle (cargo 40, 2-cycle round trip), margin about 14/unit, trip cost 60.
